entry.title: Stone Bridge in Skopje
entry.note: Retain confirmed exact-identity outline, signed northeast long axis and southeast downstream side. Preserve the historical 241.5 m channel-bottom datum as an explicitly approximate rendering reference. Replace only the overlapping longitudinal bridge-road corridor and directly connected end fragments; retain all buildings, unrelated roads, original DEM and native river/shorelines. Current native fit must be inspected before approval. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
